title: The Hunter and the Hag
author: leechykeen
description:
Once upon a time, there was a king with three sons. One was brave, one clever, and one kind. Then, they each encountered the same loathly lady...

Based on the ballad of King Henry (among other fairy tales), The Hunter and the Hag offers several possible endings. Some are happy and some are grim, but none of them are undeserved.

(CW for animal death, blood)
(don't worry-- all the animals are fine, actually. I promise)
